title: إنفانتينو يعلن إقامة كأس العالم تحت 15 سنة بمشاركة 211 منتخبا
summary: "ستكون بمثابة مهرجان للأطفال"

title: Nightdive's Thief remaster unearths a 'very very out of date version control repository' with 'the wildest things to say about the code'
summary: "The way they do the lighting is exactly the same as Quake," says Nightdive's Josh Dowell.
body: It's great that the Nightdive's remasters of various classic games give new players a chance to experience them without having to download a fixpack or remap the controls or whatever, but it's also a wonderful opportunity to learn new things about games we already loved. Each remaster is like an archaeological dig and you never know what it'll uncover. Digital Foundry's Retro Super Show recently spoke to Nightdive about their current project, a remaster of Looking Glass Studio's stealth classic Thief: The Dark Project. If you're super into the minutiae of Thief, as you should be, it's a cool insight into the making of the game and in particular, the Dark Engine that powers it. "There's nothing else like it even to this day," Nightdive software engineer Josh Dowell says. As he explains, Nightdive got to see "a very very out of date version control repository for the code" and that made the origins of its oddities more obvious. But what should have been a triumphant early access launch went pear shaped very quickly. At launch, few talked about the quite distinctive worldbuilding or the parry-heavy combat. summary: ماذا قال؟
body: ماذا قال؟ اختار المصري حمزة عبد الكريم أن يرد على عدم مشاركته في مواجهة برشلونة أمام إلتشي برسالة هادئة تحمل قدرًا كبيرًا من الثقة والصبر، مؤكدًا أن الفرصة قد لا تأتي اليوم، لكن الأهم بالنسبة له هو الاستعداد الكامل للحظة التي يحين فيها موعد الظهور. وكتب مهاجم برشلونة الشاب عبر حساباته على مواقع التواصل الاجتماعي عقب المباراة: "لا دقائق اليوم. يبقى التركيز قائمًا. سأظل مستعدًا لحظة المشاركة عندما تأتي"، في رسالة عكست تعامله الإيجابي مع قرار عدم الدفع به، وتمسكه بالاستعداد بدلًا من الانشغال بغيابه عن أرض الملعب. وجاءت رسالة حمزة عقب الانتصار الكبير الذي حققه برشلونة على إلتشي بنتيجة 5-0، في مباراة اعتمد خلالها الألماني هانزي فليك على رافينيا في مركز المهاجم الصريح، بينما منح الدقائق الهجومية لأسماء أخرى، في ظل المنافسة القوية على مراكز الخط الأمامي. ورغم عدم حصوله على فرصة المشاركة، بدا حمزة حريصًا على إرسال رسالة مختلفة تمامًا؛ إذ لم يتضمن حديثه أي اعتراض أو شكوى، وإنما ركز على الجاهزية وانتظار الفرصة، وهي العقلية التي يحتاجها اللاعب الشاب في بداية تجربته مع الفريق الأول.

body: Last week, the Communications Workers of America and the Bethesda Game Studios OneBGS union took part in the Save Our Devs rally across the United States and Canada (and on Twitch ) "to call out layoffs and corporate greed across the industry and to demand fair first contracts across Microsoft’s gaming studios." Speaking to Kotaku , Bethesda artist Alex Nguyen talked about how things changed after Bethesda was acquired by the tech giant. "Since we’ve been under Microsoft… it feels like something has changed. We didn’t have layoffs before, and now all of a sudden we have yearly layoffs," he told Kotaku, saying teams were feeling the effects of cuts which eroded institutional knowledge. “If only five people knew how this thing worked and you let all five of them go, that’s a morale killer because it’s like we already knew this, and now we have to learn it again.” According to that article, Nguyen pointed out that fixer-uppers like Fallout 76 and Elder Scrolls Online don't get a chance to bloom into successful fan favorites without sufficient labor and time. body: Critical Hit (Image credit: Future) Welcome to Critical Hit , where I (or someone else on the PC Gamer team) celebrate and lament all things videogame music, audio design, and the ways our favourite games make our ears tingle. Last month, Final Fantasy 10 turned 25 years old—a fact that has utterly shaken my perception of the passage of time, leaving me to slowly decay into a pile of dust. It remains one of my favourite JRPGs of all time, even if PC only has the significantly weirder-looking, plastic-faced HD remaster. The romance! The belts! The turn-based battling! The cutscenes! Things that all still very much hold up two-and-a-half decades later, in my humble and not at all biased opinion. But one aspect that has endured above all others is the game's soundtrack. title: EverQuest Legends dev says 'I'm sure we would' add new classes, races 'in the longer-term vision of the game'

body: EverQuest Legends, the EverQuest spinoff that remixes an old-school version of the early MMORPG into a multiclassing, froglok-murdering ARPG minmaxer's paradise , has a lot on the way. In a recent Twitch stream , developers from Daybreak Games and Game Jawn floated some pretty big ideas for the future: perhaps most notably, all-new classes that weren't in the original EverQuest at all. "Definitely, I think, long-term we have discussed additional races, additional classes. Is it realistic to have another class by [the upcoming expansion] Kunark? I don't think so," said Daybreak executive producer David Youssefi. "But definitely would not rule it out for the longer-term vision of the game. In fact, I'm sure we would." Game Jawn CEO and technical director Eda Spause chimed in, "Yeah, absolutely." Granted, they were careful to temper expectations.
